lines.text: Sunlight falls on a messy living room: crumbs, socks, a toppled mug.
@samurai steps in, bows, and rolls up his sleeves.
He sweeps the floor in swift, precise strokes.
A blade flashes and slices a cloud of dust in two.
He wipes the last smudge from the window glass.
@samurai bows to the spotless room, calm and still.
Your home is clean. Rest now.

writes.note: I drafted a short one-room script that shows @samurai doing the cleaning, from your line.

reply.rationale: Turned the one-line brief into a 15 s single-location scene of about 14 s by rule 10, with one short spoken line and the bare @samurai kept.
